details.s: Celebrimbor was a Ñoldorin prince and the last in the line of the House of Fëanor, who lived in Middle-earth. He was a ruler of Eregion in the Second Age, and a master smith. He is remembered primarily for his creation of the Three Rings of Power: Nenya, Vilya, and Narya, but also he made the second Elfstone (in one version of history) for Galadriel, who would later give it to Aragorn.
f: Prince of the Ñoldor, Lord of Eregion, Lord of the Gwaith-i-Mírdain
